Developers.metaDescription: Iwadika akiro kanu aitogogong ka aisiom Zuula aingic naka abeit kotoma aswamisinei kon nuka iyemuto.

banner.description: Ipedori ijo aijukar akiro kanu awanyanario kosodi asiom nuikamunitos akiro nuka abeit kotoma aiboisit kon naka iyemuto.

preview.title: Aanyunet, ejai aijulakinio kitoni v1
preview.body: Erai lo aanyunet nasodit naka API kanuka arotak iyemuto keda ipaupa. Mam epedorio ainomakin eringa: ejaasi backend toma Atutubet 2, ido akiro, aiboisio keda ikisila epedorete aijulakin eringa epone loka 1.

overview.title: Aiwanyanario
overview.body: Zuula API einakini arotak iyemuto lu ecamunitai keda iriongeta luejaasi keda apedor naepol noi naka aitogogongio naka zuula.ug. Epedorete aanyanario aswam kotoma apak naegelegela:
overview.step1: Ijukak akiro mama ejai POST /v1/checks. Idumuni jo aanyanaret ID katipet.
overview.step3: Kosiom akiro nu etubokinio, amunokina na ikapun, aitetem ka aiwadikaeta kotoma akiro nuelomunitos.
overview.format: JSON kotoma HTTPS (UTF-8). Eraasi apakio nuka aitolot ISO 8601 kotoma UTC.

auth.title: Aitogogongio
auth.body: Ekoto aingiset kere API key kotoma Authorization header. Epedorete arotak iyemuto lu itigogongoritai keda eyaitok aitolomun ka alemar ikisila ko Akaunt → API adumunun. Egeunos ikisila keda zl_live_ ido itodiaritai irwan idiope bon.

scopes.submit: Kijukak akiro, ikoruo, akiro keda aputosia kanu airereor.
scopes.read: Kosiom akiro nu aanyanaret kosodi aimo akiro nuka abeit.

auth.serverOnly: Sirikibwa API key toma aweb page, mobile app arai bo public repository. Inom API kotoma osava kon kosodi alemar key kere loepedori aitodiar.

rate.title: Aitikitik ikapun
rate.body: Epedori akirot ngin aitolomun {limit} ailipasinei kangol esawa. Kangin abongokinet itodunit ikapun luideuna. Arai kilelebikin ijo, ebongonokinete API abongonokineta 429 Too Many Requests: idarak sekondin luka Retry-After eringa iuta aitam bobo.

headers.limit: Ecamakinitai ailipasinei kotoma osawa kanuka ekisil lo.
headers.remaining: Aingiseta nu apotu kesi kojalakisi kotoma osawa kalo.
headers.reset: Neiteteunor ekapun, kwape Unix timestamp kotoma atikatikan.
headers.retryAfter: Ijukunitai keda 429 abongokineta: atikatikan nuka aidar eringa bobo aitam.

submit.title: Ijukakini aanyanaret
submit.body: Ijukak ibore idiope kanu aanyunet. Itwasam JSON kanu akiro, arucokina keda akiro, ido multipart/form-data kanu akiro nuka elago. Ebuni abongokinet adolun katipet keda aitodunet ID; aanyanar bon eyangaikini nepetai 10 atikatikan kanu akiro keda kitoni edakika ediope kanu akiro nuka elago.

fields.type: Ibore yen ijukari ijo: text, url, article arai bo media.
fields.content: Akirot na ekoto aanyun. Kitoni {textMax} akiro kanu akirot, {articleMax} kanu akiro nuka akiro. Ekotoi kanu akirot keda akiro.
fields.url: Aikamanario naepol noi naka http arai bo https mama ejai akiro nuka iyemuto arai bo ewebusait. Ekotoi kanu url.
fields.file: Aputo, aijukaret naka eporoto arai bo ebidio, kitoni {size}. JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, AAC, MP4, MOV, WebM arai bo 3GP. Ekotoi kanu akiro nuka iyemuto.
fields.headline: Akirot naepol noi naka akiro, kitoni {max} itunga.
fields.language: Angajep naka akiro: en, lg, ach, nyn, teo, arai bo auto kanu ajenun ngin (nges loedit).

status.title: Adumun akiro
status.body: Inyakuni ejautene loka aanyanaret. Nejaatar ejautene erai completed, ejaasi akiro nuka result keda akiro kere nuka aanyanaret. Esubit bala enaaba loka aitodun akiro kwape ZL-7K3P-Q9.

states.processing: Euta aanyanario naka akiro ngun keda atukona nuemuno ka AI-detection models.
states.failed: Mam epedorio angetakin aanyanaret. Ebala aiboisit naka aibucaret kanukinyo.

search.title: Aingic akiro nu aanyanario
search.body: Koomoom aiboisit naka itunga naejaasi keda akiro nuikamunitos akiro nukabeit. Ejaasi akiro ngun keda adoketait naepol noi kotoma Aitogogongoret Naka Itunga keda apak, ido akiro nuemamete aomisio nuepedorete airereor kes mam imarunitai.

params.q: Akiro nu ekotoi aanyun kotoma apapulai, akiro nuikamunitos akiro keda akiro nu iwanyunitai.
params.category: Kotub kotoma akirot, kwape nat angaleu arai bo aseo.
params.language: Kotoma aiboisit na angajep naka akiro nu iwanyunitai.
params.dates: Aanyanaret na iswamao kotoma arai akaulo naka, ido kotoma arai eringa, apaarasia nu (YYYY-MM-DD).
params.perPage: Akiro nuka atutubet, anyoun kotoma 1 kitoni 50. Aitemonokineta 20.

factCheck.title: Aingic akiro nuka abeit
factCheck.body: Aponi kitemokinai aanyanario ka akiro nuka aimo kes ejaasi keda epone lo. Epedorete ikiroria ajaut emamei idiobore; epedorio aiyatakin akiro eringa v1 konye mam elemarere.

fields.id: Erai ID loepol noi loka aanyanario naka akiro.
fields.trackingId: Abu aingic ID kobongok neyangaunere akiro.
fields.confidence: Ejaasi Zuula keda amuno naepol noi kotoma atubokinio, anyoun ko 0 kitoni 100.
fields.findings: Akiro nuikidioko nuikamunitos iboro lumam eraasi abeit keda luabeit.
fields.claims: Akiro nu edumunitai kotoma akirot, keda aiboisio nuka itunga, aingic, akirot na eyangauni ka aitoduneta nuigangitos ngun.
fields.citations: Iboro lu itwasamat, keda ekiror, apapula, arucokina, apaaran naka aitolomun ka epone loejai: supports, contradicts arai bo context.
fields.aiSignals: Aanyanario kanu AI loitolomunitai arai bo loitemonokinitai, kangin keda apointan, atutubet naepol noi keda epone.
fields.community: Aitemonokineta nu abeit ka numam abeit kanu aanyanario naka itunga, arotak iyemuto keda ipirioitin.
fields.humanReview: Ejai ne itigogongoritor epirioit arai bo aitepeg atubokineta, keda aitijenaretakec.

errors.title: Aibucanareta

Home.subtitle: Ibusakinit jo aipikakin emesej, arai bo aipikakin aiboisit arai bo aipikakin akiro. Zuula itijenikini jo arai erai abeit, mam erai abeit arai bo AI-etolomunitai — ido <scribble>itodunit jo akiro nu elomunitos</scribble>.

About.metaDescription: Zuula alosikinet, epone lo itolosere aswam, aipugaikin bon ka FAQ.

banner.title: Kanuikamunitos
banner.description: Aswam wok, epone lo itwasamatere ka aipugaikin bon.

why.title: Edukunitai kanu epone lo elosere iyemuto ko Uganda.

sources.title: Iboro lu emunoi
sources.body: Ejaasi akiro ngun keda aiboisio nuka Uganda ka akwapin ace ka itunga lu inwakete abeit.

ai.title: AI ajenunet naka akiro
ai.body: Aputosia nu emukule AI-nu itolomunitai kotoma aiwadikaeta, aputosia nuka abeit, ikososinei luka aiswamaun keda ebidio loitemonokinitai.

languages.title: Angajepisinei nuka Uganda
languages.body: English, Luganda, Acholi, Runyankole keda Ateso.

mission.title: Ejaasi Uganda keda aiyatakinio naka akiro nu ijukunitai kanginipaaran. Zuula eanyanari kes eringa ijo imorikina.
mission.body: Zuula (kotoma aiboisit naka Uganda Fact-Guard) erai AI-ingarakinit aanyanario naka akiro nuikamunitos epone loelomunia iyemuto kane — ko WhatsApp, kotoma aineranara naka egurupu keda elago, duc katipet adepar aiboisit adio naka iyemuto naepedori aitogogong ngun. Ijukak akirot kosodi adumun aomisioit naegogong keda aitogogongoret, mere aomisioit bon.

methodology.title: Epone lo edolunia oni aomisioit
methodology.description: Aanyanario kangin etupakinit ainapeta aongon nueputosi, arai itolosio bon arai bo eyangaritai mama ejai loingicete.

submit.title: Iwadika akiro nuikamunitos aibucaret
submit.body: Ibusakinit jo aipikakin akiro, aimor elink arai bo aipikakin akiro (kitoni 50 MB). Idumuni jo aingic ID ido ipedori atupakinit aingic ngin kotoma apak naejok.

check.title: Iwadika sio ngun
check.body: Erai akirot ngin naepol noi kotoma aanyanario naka Uganda keda akwapin ace, ido aponi itolosai kanu AI-abu kitolomu akiro, deepfakes keda akiro nuikamunitos eporoto arai bo ebidio.

publish.title: Aponi kitolomunai abongokinet
publish.body: Iwanyunit jo atubokinio, ajenanut na ejai kauke ido ngai bo ecamunitos arai mam ecamunitos — mam erai akirot bon.

review.title: Ejaasi itunga keda lu ebeit aanyanar akiro
review.body: Itunga lu esiomakete itodunitos epone lo etubere. Arai mam itunga luipu ecamunitos, epedori Epirioit lo ajenara airereor emusago ngol kosodi aitigogong arai bo alemar — aponi koinakinai eripoota ngol "Human Verified."

independence.title: Ikisila lu itwasama oni kanu aitikitik
independence.description: Mam epedorio agwelun aomisio nuka Zuula, ido mam eraasi nu awasia arai emamei epone lo itepegere kes.

label.title: Iwadikaete oni, mam oni imudiarit
label.body: Zuula mam itolomuni akiro nuka itunganan. Iwadikakini sio aomisioit naejok keda aitogogongoret nepepe ka ngin.

rules.title: Ejaasi aipim kere keda ikisila lueputosi
rules.body: Erai aingito naka itunga, luka iyemuto keda luka ipirioitin lu eyaunitos aiyalama na itunga, kotupitete akiro nu iswamao — emamei aseo na mam ecamakitai komam ejai alosikinet.

accountable.title: Ebeit aanyanarak aitodun ebe ejokuna
accountable.body: Aitijenaret naepol ekoto aitetem akiro keda aiwadikaeta nuikamunitos akiro ngun nuepedorete eyaitok airereor.

sources.title: Itodunitai lu itolomunete, mere aingop
sources.body: Ejaasi aingadis ngin keda akiro nuikamunitos akiro nuetapit ngesi aanyanar, kanu ijo aanyun aomisio wok bon.

whatsapp.title: Koanyana aomisioit kama ejai WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Emamei app, emamei data bundle kanu aiboisit na elosere akiro — ijukakini akirot kosodi adumun abongokinet kotoma oiner.
whatsapp.body: Etemokinitai WhatsApp keda Telegram bot kanu atutubet naka API, aso ipedori ijo aijukar emesej atipet mama ejai Zuula kwape ijukari jo ngun mama ejaasi ipaperokon. Mam erai loejok kopana — kanu kwana, itwasam <link>Kitogogong</link> kotoma olago.

free.a: Aanyanar akiro nu elimunitai ka aisiom eitabo loka Akiro erai lo atitai kanuka itunga kere. Akauntin nuka ewadikan keda epirioit ekotosi aitigogongoret, naarai ejaasi kesi keda apedor naepol noi kotoma aingito naka atutubet ido epedorete airereor imusagon lu itemokinitai.

submit.a: Akiro (kwape nat WhatsApp alosit), arucokina, akiro kere, arai bo iboro — aputosia, aiwadikaeta nuka eporoto ka ebidio kitoni 50 MB.

time.q: Erai bo ai apak na eyangaikinor aanyanaret?
time.a: Etapit duc akiro aijaikin nepetai 10 atikatikan. Epedorete imediam aijaikin kitoni idakikan ediope. Imusagon lu iyatakitai mama ejai loetapit aanyanar etupitos apak na aanyanario.

disagree.q: Ani bo arai mam eong acamanara keda atubokinio?
disagree.a: Kotub aitelekaarit. Aitelekaarit na elomunit kama ejaasi itunga, arotak iyemuto keda ipirioitin imorikikin toma Atukot Naka Amunokina. Arai ebuni aitelekaarit naka atubokin aibiror kwap noi keda aitelekaarit naepol, itodiaritai kanu ipirioitin airereor ka aitigogong arai bo aijulakin.

languages.a: Epedorio aanyanar akiro ngun ko English, Luganda, Acholi, Runyankole keda Ateso. Euta aiboisit ngin aijulakinio toma angajepisinei ngun da; ibore yen mam ber ijulakinitai itodiaritai ko English.

data.a: Kotoma aitutuket naka Uganda naka ayuarite akiro keda aiyeyea, 2019. Kosesen <link>Aicoreta nuka Aiyeyea</link> wok.

who.a: Zuula (“Uganda Fact-Guard”) nes etolomunitai ko Centre for Intelligent Technologies ko Victoria University Kampala kwape epurojekt loka asioman keda aiyalama naka itunga. Aponi kodumunai abongonokineta komamete agangat arai bo adumanar ikapun.

contact.description: Aingiseta nuikamunitos atubokinio, elago arai bo aiswamanara.

general.title: Aingiseta nuapolok
general.body: Eipone lo itolomere, aiswamanara keda akiro nuka elago.

cit.title: Aiboisit na itolosere acoa naka etatai loakwana

privacy.metaDescription: Epone lo Zuula atukonokin, aitwasam ka ayuarite akirokon.
privacy.title: Aiyeyea
privacy.description: Epone lo idumunere, aitwasam ka ayuarite akirokon.

overview.title: Aiwanyanario
overview.body: Itodunit ainapeta nu nuikamunitos Zuula nu etukete ne inwakini jo aipup, alosit toma Olibra arai bo aitolomun akaunt, ido epone loitosomatai ka ayuarite akiro ngun kotoma okisila loka Ekisil loka ayuarite akiro keda aiyeyea, 2019 loko Uganda. Itwasamao kanu elago loka Zuula ido, akaulo na aitegeario, WhatsApp keda Telegram bots keda ipaupa API.

items.account: Akiro nuikamunitos akaunt — ekiror, email arai enaaba loka esimu, keda aswam (Public, Journalist, Expert arai Admin).
items.submissions: Aijukar akiro — akirot, arucokina arai bo aputosia nu ingisit ijo Zuula awanyun, ido aitodunet ID na einakinitai.
items.ratings: Aitemonokineta keda iripootin — akiro nu itereikina keda, aineranara na ijaikit jo, ka akiro nu iwanyunit jo kanu aitikitik.
items.accreditation: Apapulai nu itigogongoritai — kanu itunga lu iwadikak keda lu epirioitin, ajenanut na ijaikinete yesi kanu airereor.
items.device: Akiro nuikamunitos eswamae ka aitwasam — apapulai nu epejokinitai, epone loka aiboisit naka elago ka aiboisit naejai ijo, kanu aidar ejanakine lo eyuwara ido iswamai.

items.pipeline: Aitemokin akiro ngun kotoma aiboisit wok naka awanyanario kosodi aitodiar ejauteneke keda atubokinio.
items.ccs: Aipim ka aimor aomisio nuka itunga kanu adumun Epoint Loka Amuno Naka Itunga.
items.accreditation: Aitogogong aijen naka itunga lu iwadikak keda ipirioitin, ka aiwadika aseununeta nuka itunga luitogogongitos kotoma akiro nu ebeit airereor.
items.abuse: Ajenun aswamisio nu imorikikina arai bo aitolitol aitemonokineta ka ayuarite elago kama ejaasi itunga luitolomete.
items.accuracy: Aitemonokin ka aitojokar abeit naka etube kotoma apak.

aiSharing.title: AI aingic keda itunga luka iuniet
aiSharing.body: Aanyanar akiro nu elimunitai epedori aimoriarit aijukar akiroke, arai bo aijulakin akiro nuka eporoto arai bo ebidio, mama ejai ainwakio na itolosere bon ido, kanu adumun aitogogongoret, mama ejai lo ijaikit AI lo ijaikit. Aputosia nu ipikakini jo iswamao kanu ajenun iboro luarokok eringa mam itemonokinio.
aiSharing.review: Kanu ejaasi icie kotoma aijaanakinak lu epedorete aitemonokin akiro kinga nako Uganda, iuta sio airereor alosit na akiro nuikamunitos Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2019 eringa itwasamao kinga naka aitemonokin akiro. Ebuni atutubet na aijulakin arai kedaun airereonor ngin.

dppa.title: Apedorosiokon kotoma aitutuket naka ayuwara ka aiyeyea, 2019
dppa.intro: Kwape itunganan yen ejaas keda akiro kotoma okisila luko Uganda, ijaasi jo keda apedor naka:

items.correct: Aitemokin akiro numam ebeit arai mam edolit.
items.delete: Ilipit aitolomun akiro nuka akaunt kon, kotupitete aswamisio wok nuikamunitos akiro ngun.
items.object: Aitijenar, arai aingitun oni aitikitik, aswamisio ace.
items.complain: Kotoma aiboisit naeyait akiro nuka itunga koUganda (National Information Technology Authority-Uganda) arai iwomit jo ebe mam sio iswamat ejok akirokon.

dppa.outro: Kanu aitwasam adio kotoma apedorosio nu, kodolok sio itwasamaete akiro nuejaasi toma <contact>Aingituneta nuka aineranara keda akiro</contact> kwap.

retention.title: Iwadikaete oni apak naepol noi?
retention.body: Akiro nuetolomunitai keda aitogogongoret kec eraasi atutubet naka aiwadikaeta nuka aingic akiro nuka itunga ido idaritai ikar kere, kwape ka aiwadikaeta nuka iyemuto. Akiro nuikamunitos akaunt kes idaritai nejaatar akaunt kon iswamai ido kanu apak naedit akaulo, kanu aigang aiwadikaeta nuka aanyanario keda aitigogongio nu ekotoi kanu ainwakio. Akiro nuikamunitos malware-scanned upload kes idaritai bon arai ipudasi kanu aitolomun akiro nuetolomunitai.

cookies.title: Cookies keda aingadao naiboisit
cookies.body: Itosomai sio a session cookie kanu aidar jo iwadikatai, keda aiboisit naka aingadao kanu aiitun atutubet kon keda angajep na ikoto ijo kotoma acuma kana. Mam sio itosomai adoketait naiuniet naka aitodiar akiro.

children.title: Aiyeyea naka idwe
children.body: Zuula erai loitemokinitai kanuka itunga luejaasi keda ikar 18 keda lu edeparitos. Mam sio imoriarit akiro nuka itunga luka idwe, ido ibuni sio alemar nu ejaasi oni keda ajenunet.

changes.title: Aijulanakineta toma ainapeta nu
changes.body: Ibusakinit sio aijulakin apaaran naejai kuju naka atutubet kana kangolisawa loejulakinor ainapeta nu, kosodi aipikakin akiro nuegelegela toma <home>Esite loapolon</home> eringa kes iswamaunos.

contact.title: Aingituneta nuka aineranara keda akiro
contact.body: Kotoma aijukar email <email>privacy@zuula.ug</email> kanu aingiset adio kere nuikamunitos ainapeta nu arai bo aitodolikin apedorosiokon kotoma Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2019. Kosesen bobo <terms>Akiro nu itwasamaere</terms>.

acceptance.title: Acamun akiro nu
acceptance.body: Kotoma aitwasam Zuula — elago, ido kotoma oingaren WhatsApp/Telegram bots keda ipaupa API — icamunit jo akiro nu. Arai mam ijo icamunit, kilipit mam itwasam ejanakine ngol.

service.title: Inyoin bo Zuula erai (ka mam erai)
service.body: Zuula inwakini akiro, arucokina keda iyemuto itwasamaete ajenunet naka acuma ido, ne eyatakinor emusago, airereonor naka itunga kanejaas itunga luecamunitai. Akirot naepol itodunit aanyanaret wok najokan kakere naka aitogogongoret naejai neitolomunere, ido epedori aijulakin arai etakanuni aitogogongoret najokan. Zuula erai ibore yenitemonokinete abeit, mere aicoreta nuka ikisila, amukian arai ikapun, ido mam akirot naepol erai aiboisit naka aseununeta kon.

items.roles: Epedori itunganan kere aiwadikaun kwape itunganan yen itunga. Aswamisinei nuka arotak iyemuto keda ipirioitin ekotosi aitigogongoret.
items.accurate: Koinak akiro nu abeit ne iwadikauna arai bo ne ilipia aanyunet.
items.one: Kotoma aingadis naka ikapun, itunganan kangin ejaasi keda akaunt adiope bon ido ibusakinit jo ajaut keda akiro nuikamunitos akaunt kon.
items.twoFactor: Ekotoi aitogogongio naka akiro aarei kanu akaunts nuka Expert keda Admin.

submissions.title: Aijukak kon
submissions.body: Ibusakinit jo ajaut keda apedor naka aimor ibore kere yen ijaikit jo kanu aanyanario. Sirikijaik akiro numam ekisil ecamakinit, nu itolitolete aiyeyea naka icie itunganan, arai bo numam ijaasi jo keda acamakinet naka aimor.
submissions.publish: Ejaasi ifayil lu iyatakinio keda aanyanario naka malware eringa aingic. Aijukar ka atubokin Zuula loedolit epedori alimor kwape ediope kotoma aiwadikaeta nuka aanyanario naka akiro, kwape nat epone loitolomunere iyemuto nu itolomete akiro nu aanyanarete.

ratings.title: Aitemonokineta nuka itunga keda iponesio
ratings.body: Kotema akiro nuka aomisio keda abeit, kotupitete aitodunet na itodiaritai. Aswamisioit na aimar arai bo aijulakin (kwape awanyunet, igurupun luka akauntin aimar nepepe kanu aitopolor adoketait naka aomisio) epedori aitidisiar ainapeta kec kosodi aikisar akauntin nu ajaasi toma. Ipedori jo alimor akiro arai bo aimar na esubit bala ejulakinitai kotoma atutubet naka alimoret.

api.title: API keda adumununeta nuka etolomak
api.body: Epedorete arotak iyemuto keda akaunts nuka eyaitok ailip API keys kanejai <keys>Akaunt → API Ipuak luka akiro</keys>. Aitodolikinio naka Partner API ejai aitikitik (kwana {limit} ailipasinei/hour) ido ejaasi ikisila toma akaunt kon — mam imorata kes. Kosesen <dev>Atutubet naka etolomak</dev> kanu akiro nuipu.

ip.title: Iboro luka acoa
ip.body: Ekiror loka Zuula, aanyunet keda akiro nuka elago eraasi luka Centre for Intelligent Technologies, Victoria University Kampala. Ijaikitai jo aimor, aitodunet keda aiwadik akiro nuka Zuula nuewadikatai keda aijaikin akiro keda arucokina naka abongun toma oripoota.

disclaimer.title: Abeit keda aitikitik ikapun lu itwasamatere
disclaimer.body: Iwanyanari sio akiro kere nu elimunitai kotoma aiyuun naejok kosodete aitodiar ajenanut na ejai kau naka atubokineta, konye mam sio ijaikini aitigogongoret ebe emamei aibucaret kotoma atubokineta. Kotoma adoketait naecamakinitai ikisila luko Uganda, Zuula keda Victoria University CIT mam epedoritos aitolitol aseununeta nu itolomunitai kotupitete atubokineta.

termination.title: Aitobwoun ka aitanang
termination.body: Ipedori sio aiyap arai agolokin akaunt kanu aitwasam erono, aijulakin adoketait naka akiro, arai bo aibil ikisila lu. Ipedori jo agolokin akaunt kon apak kere kotoma aiboisio nuka akaunt.

law.title: Ekisil lo eyait
law.body: Ejaasi akiro nu keda ikisila luka akwap nako Uganda.

changes.title: Aijulanakineta toma akiro nu
changes.body: Ipedori oni aijulakin akiro nu kwape eyatakinor esitesen. Ibusakinit oni aijulakin apaaran naejai kuju neitodiar oni; ainyikokin aitwasam Zuula akaulo naka aijulakin apolouke ebe icamunit jo akiro nuitetiak.

contact.title: Kontak
contact.body: Aingiseta nuikamunitos akiro nu? Email <email>hello@zuula.ug</email>. Koany da <privacy>Aicoreta nuka Aiyeyea</privacy> wok.
